title: Memo on Length of Service and the Lapse Allowance of a Wayfare Document Hold
content:
**Product:** Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.
**Subject:** the lapse allowance days of a document hold, meaning the calendar days a hold for an expired document may run from its hold start date before it ends in deactivation for document lapse, and how long the agreement has been active.

## Rule

An agreement active at least 1825 calendar days, counted from its activation date to the day the allowance is worked out, adds 10 days to the lapse allowance days; one active at least 730 but fewer than 1825 days adds 5 days; one active fewer than 730 days adds none.

## Decision table

| Days active (activation date to the day the allowance is worked out) | Days added to the lapse allowance days |
|---|---|
| 1825 or more | 10 |
| 730 to 1824 | 5 |
| 729 or fewer | 0 |

The days active are the calendar days from the activation date on the agreement to the day the allowance is worked out; the activation date is read from the agreement.

## Boundaries (hypothetical agreements, allowance worked out on 2026-06-01)

| Activation date | Days active | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 2021-06-02 | 1825 | 10 |
| 2021-06-03 | 1824 | 5 |
| 2024-06-01 | 730 | 5 |
| 2024-06-02 | 729 | 0 |

Only the days active decide this figure.
